title: Receipt signature
description: A detached Ed25519 signature over one receiptId, produced by the human-run signer with the passphrase-encrypted private key. This is the one artifact in the store that IS a signature: it proves the passphrase holder authorized this exact receipt. It says nothing about the store around it.

signature.description: Base64 of the detached Ed25519 signature over the receiptId string.

keyFingerprint.description: sha256 of the raw public key bytes. Verification also demands it equal the anchored fingerprint.
